candidate.rationale: ExecSpecEq already supplies the strongest contract: res == (this.deep_view() =~~= other.deep_view()). Repeating it on the implementation is redundant, and no stronger implementation-specific postcondition follows soundly from these bounds.
risks: The external_body leaves the inherited contract unverified against runtime behavior.
Non-injective K::deep_view may make Rust HashSet equality differ from deep-view equality.
